newsitem.title: UK: Logica buys Axime unit for 18.4 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Logica buys Axime unit for 18.4 mln stg.

text.p: UK software group Logica Plc said on Thursday that it has bought Axime Ingenierie SA, part of French computer services group Axime, for 18.4 million stg.
Logica said the unit is part of the systems integration and professional services division of Axime, together with the Luxembourg and Belgian operations of the division.
The acquisition will be financed from cash reserves and borrowings and Logica expects the purchase to make a small contribution to its earnings in the current financial year.
By 0820 GMT, Logica shares were 16p higher at 877-1/2.
